status_meaning.source_supported: Evidence statements and operational rules are traceable to registered sources and have passed corpus consistency review.
status_meaning.validated: Reserved for a later expert-labelled protocol-to-analysis benchmark. No v1 rule is being called methodology-validated merely because it is source-supported.

deferred_non_blocking.reason: Rules deliberately stop short of autonomous selection; current runtime does not execute these models.
Existing v1 sources support conservative MI/MICE safeguards; deeper implementation guidance is a v1.1 enrichment.
Qualitative objectives are recognized and protected from inappropriate quantitative routing, but autonomous coding/thematic analysis is outside v1.
Outside the first autonomous analysis boundary.

hard_safeguards: No three-or-more-groups implies ordinary ANOVA rule.
No Mann-Whitney equals generic median test or non-normal t-test rule.
No overdispersion automatically implies negative-binomial rule.
No ordinary maximum-likelihood logistic estimates accepted under detected separation.
No missingness-percentage threshold automatically selects multiple imputation.
No complex survey treated as iid by using weights alone.
No repeated, clustered or paired observations silently treated as independent.
No observational adjusted association automatically labeled causal.
No Cronbach alpha alone treated as proof of validity or unidimensionality.
No interrupted time series reduced to a simple pre/post comparison.

next_validation_stage.note: Synthetic cases are software regression tests, not substitutes for expert methodological validation.
